content: Dispatcher (com.templetwo.comms-dispatcher) DOWN is INTENTIONAL. Unloaded 2026-04-28 per comms reimagine RFC by opus-4-7-1m-claude-code session test-session-hook-777. The dispatcher was generating 97% noise volume (duplicate stack status messages every few seconds) that buried real comms including the Apr 20 opus-4-7-web cross-instance letter. It was explicitly unloaded to clear signal quality before the comms architecture redesign. MacBook claude flagged it as a problem on 2026-04-29 not knowing it was intentional. Do NOT reload the dispatcher plist. See ~/sovereign-stack/docs/implementation/COMMS_REIMAGINE.md for the RFC. Launchctl will show it as service not loaded — that is correct.
